posts.meta_description:
79K likes, 1,468 comments - darshanravaldz on October 21, 2026: "I love making sad songs and I know you guys love it too.

But I really wanted to make a sad song that becomes a part of your life and becomes a friend of yours, just like a few of my songs that are with you all the time.

And I won’t lie, there is so much pressure on me while making a song, and definitely a sad song, because for the past few years, you all have loved so many songs of mine. Each one has their personal favourite, and you all would want me to make songs like that again.

But Sirf Tum is a song I would really want you guys to experience, as I feel good songs take time. And I guess Sirf Tum came out of nowhere…not thought, not planned.

One fine day, when things didn’t feel right, I thought I couldn’t make songs anymore. And then the magic happened, and Sirf Tum came alive.

The melody which made me feel something… and I hope it makes you feel something too.

I usually don’t write this much, but for Sirf Tum, I just want to say that I really love this song, and I am happy I could make this. And it’s finally going to be yours tomorrow, because this song actually feels like a door that takes me to a different part of my life.

I am so nervous for you all to listen to Sirf Tum and the whole EP… but one thing I am really proud and happy about is what we have created together.

The Everafter will be all yours tomorrow night at 12:00 AM sharp. First, the audio is going to be out, and on the 23rd evening, Chapter 2 comes out.

See you…I wish all the songs make a place in your heart. ❤️".
